module_summary: AXI-stream 1:N frame demultiplexer: at frame start latches select/drop, steers the valid bit to the selected output (or drops the frame) through a registered output stage with skid buffer, releasing at tlast.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: 2-state idle/in-frame controller; select/drop latched only when idle

anchors.name: select_reg
anchors.why: latched output index for current frame, steers valid to one output

anchors.name: drop_reg
anchors.why: frame drop flag; suppresses output valid and forces input ready

anchors.name: select
anchors.why: requested output port captured at frame start

anchors.name: drop
anchors.why: request to discard the starting frame

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: input beat valid; frame start/end detection and output valid

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: registered input ready ANDed with enable

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: input payload passed to internal datapath

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: per-output valid vector from output register

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: output data register replicated to all outputs

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_int
anchors.why: one-hot internal valid shifted by select_ctl, zero when dropping

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: internal registered ready from output stage to input logic

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: skid register holding beat while outputs stall

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: skid occupancy per output; gates internal ready and temp-to-output

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: loads internal beat into output registers

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: loads internal beat into skid registers

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: moves skid contents to output registers

groups.name: Frame routing control
groups.description: Latches select/drop at frame start, holds until tlast, drives input ready

groups.name: Valid steering
groups.description: Shifts beat valid to selected output; data passes through unchanged

groups.name: Output register stage
groups.description: Registered outputs replicated to all ports with per-port valid

groups.name: Skid buffer
groups.description: Temp registers absorb a beat when outputs stall
